author: Aritra Dutta

contents.content: Karnataka is characterized by its rich culture and varied landscapes, with some of the world's most beautiful beaches along its coast. Here, you will find retreat spots hidden away from the public or else hotspots with life and drama. Here we present to you the beautiful beaches in Karnataka that stand out due to their unique features, activities, and attractions.

Om beach is located in Gokarna. In this place, every beach lover can find a reason to come here. You will definitely treasure the view here, which is bewitching, especially when the sunset takes place. Such beauties have been enjoyed from the shacks provided on both sides as one sits here to enjoy the affordable accommodation coupled with the delicious food being served in the restaurants that offer global cuisines. Besides, one can also enjoy surfing, speedboats, etc.

Distance from Bangalore: 491 km
Best Time to Visit: October to March
Activities

  • Surfing
  • Parasailing
  • Jet Ski Ride

Maravanthe Beach lies at a distance of 12kms from Kundapura. It is one of the virgin beaches that has not been devastated by human hands. The Kodachadri Hills encircle the beach and make up for one of the wonderful views there.Even at night, the beach is a marvellous sight for the eyes as the street lights reflect on the water. The beach is safe for swimming. The one thing that attracts the visitors is the delicious & savoury food that is served out here!
Walking on this calm, pristine beach gives a panoramic view of the ocean blue waters, soothing waters and the stunning mountains that cover the beach.
One has so many ways to spend time on the beach from basking in the sun to scuba diving and so on. The waters of the Maravanthe beach are rich in marine life and are great for swimming in serene waves. Never miss the glorious sunsets at this famous beach.
Distance from Bangalore: 441Km
Best Time to Visit: September and March

Activities

  • Swimming
  • Scuba Diving
  • Water Sports

One of the most scenic beaches around Udupi, Malpe Beach is one that you will most certainly come across. Don't forget to visit St. Mary's Island for some breathtaking views of the ocean. Engage in some thrilling water sports or perhaps take a camel ride, this beach has loads of fun activities in it.

Distance from Bangalore: 406.6 km
Best Time to Visit: October and January
Activities

  • Water Sports
  • Boating to St. Mary’s Island
  • Photography

Tannirbhavi beach is known for the natural scenes and soothing atmosphere. This one is at Mangalore, which takes nearly 6 to 7 hours of drive from the main city. Along with the popular Panambur Beach in Mangalore, don't miss this one also. It is less crowded and perfect to enjoy a silent evening with some refreshing drinks.

Distance from Bangalore: 356.1 km
Best Time to Visit: September to February

Activities

  • Bar hopping 
  • surfing
  • coastline glamming

Karwar beach, also known as Tagore Beach, is one among the best beaches in Karnataka. It is located at the mouth of the Kali river and at the Arabian Sea in the midst of Karwar town.

Far less crowded, you will surely find this beach to be quite an excellent place to relax. There are a few museums nearby, which you can explore as well while you are in stay. Food will not be an issue also as the main city is just a mile away where you will find a number of great restaurants and bars.

Distance from Bangalore: 512.6 km
Best Time to Visit:September and February

Activities

  • Camping
  • Nature Walks
  • Local Markets

Murudeshwar beach is situated along the Murudeshwar Temple and one of Karnataka's best beaches. The beach is ideal for family members to go on a picnic.Further, this beach is surrounded by soft sloping hills and greenery and is made of sand with silky texture. If you visit this place early in the morning, you may find kingfisher birds and seagulls, which makes it look even more aesthetic.

Distance from Bangalore: 500.3 km
Best Time to Visit: October to February

Activities

  • Surfing
  • boating
  • Kayaking

Another major beach in Karnataka is Panambur Beach, and it falls into the list of most visited places around the Mangalore city. It is also known for mesmerising sunsets with enthralling adventurous activities, including parasailing and jet skiing. You can also opt for a camel or horse ride here. In case you are in search of a spot to have an awesome time with your family, then you can surely visit this beach. Plan a day out at beach resorts close to Bangalore in Mangalore to have an exciting experience.

Distance from Bangalore: 342 km
Best Time to Visit: November to June

Activities:

  • Parasailing
  • jet skiing
  • boating

Travel Tips for Visiting Beaches

Best Times to Visit

Visits to beaches in suitable seasons could provide much more enjoyable experiences :

  • Winter (November to February):Ideal weather, especially when temperatures are pleasant.
  • Monsoon (June to September): Beauty of a sort but beware of rough seas.

Transportation Options

Most of these beaches are reached by road:

  • Car Rentals: A very easy medium of self-exploration at one's own pace.
  • Public Transport: Buses are available, but it takes quite a long time.

Accommodation Recommendations

  • Finding a place to stay can vary by location:
  • Look for beach resorts or guesthouses near your chosen beach.
  • Booking in advance can help secure better rates.
